verdict.rationale: Brex documents a first-party Webhooks API that sends real-time notifications when events happen in managed accounts, which covers the core of subscribing to events via webhooks. The evidence only states this at a summary level. Missing for 10: documented registration/subscription endpoints, the list of event types, signature verification and retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks API: Send real-time notifications based on events
Brex uses webhooks to send real-time notifications when events happen in the accounts that you manage.
